name: bpmsquare
description: BPMSquare MCP server — field service CRM for electromechanical repair businesses. Generic across every tenant; nothing here is Vikas/Hosapete-specific.

auth.description: A per-tenant API key, generated in Settings → Admin → this tenant (not a shared/global key). Send as: Authorization: Bearer <tenant API key>.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all CRM accounts. Returns OEM vendors, direct customers, and end-customers with their record counts.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get full account detail including contacts, assets, open cases, quotations, AMC contracts, work orders and invoices.

tools.name: list_cases
tools.description: List service cases. Optionally filter by status or account.

tools.name: list_quotations
tools.description: List quotations with totals and status. Optionally filter by status or account.

tools.name: list_inventory
tools.description: List inventory stock items with quantity on hand, reorder level, and preferred supplier. Optionally filter to low-stock items only.

low_stock.description: If true, only return items at or below their reorder level

tools.name: get_inventory_item
tools.description: Get full detail for one inventory item, including custom fields.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List workforce projects and sub-projects (project costing): ref, name, contract/PO code, level (0 = project, 1-3 = sub-project), parent_id, account_id, status, dates, budget hours. Filter by status, level, parent_id or account_id.

status.description: planned, active, on_hold, completed or cancelled

level.description: 0 for top-level projects only, 1-3 for sub-projects at that level

parent_id.description: Only the sub-projects directly under this project

account_id.description: Only projects for this customer account

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Fetch one workforce project: parent, level, sub-projects, and the sites, employees and shifts it is linked to.

tools.name: get_project_hours
tools.description: Worked hours for a project and everything beneath it over a date range -- the figure to invoice. Totals per project only; no per-employee detail.

tools.name: get_project_invoices
tools.description: Invoices already raised from a project's hours: the period each covers, hours and amount billed, and the invoice's status. Use before billing a period to avoid billing it twice.

tools.name: create_project_invoice
tools.description: Raise a draft invoice for a project's hours over a period, priced by the tenant's rate ladder (project rate, else employment-type rate, else workspace default). Pass dry_run=true to preview the lines without creating anything. Refuses a period already invoiced unless top_up=true bills only the hours added since.

granularity.description: One line for the project, or one per sub-project

top_up.description: Bill only the hours added since the earlier invoice for this same period

tools.name: query_project_hours
tools.description: Worked hours attributed to projects, one row per work session over the last 12 months, each with the project (and its top-level project, level and account), minutes/hours, the bill rate that applies, the billable amount, and whether it is invoiced or unassigned. Aggregate with group_by and aggregates (e.g. group_by=project.name, aggregates=sum:hours) for hours by project, account or month; filter with from/to on date.

project_id.description: Only sessions on this project (sub-projects have their own ids)

account_id.description: Only sessions on projects for this account

group_by.description: e.g. project.name, top_project.name, account.name, employment_type, date (with group_period=month)

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List the tenant's sellable products (catalog): name, SKU, category and sub-category, unit of measure, list price, its quantity breaks (qty_breaks: from-quantity and rate bands above the list price, a null rate meaning priced normally), tax percent, status and item type (a stable key such as finished_product, raw_material, bom_kit; null when not classified). Optionally filter by category, sub_category, item_type or status.

item_type.description: Only products of this item type key (e.g. raw_material, bom_kit)

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch one product by id, including description, quantity breaks (qty_breaks) and custom fields.

tools.name: list_opportunities
tools.description: List the tenant's sales deals (pipeline): title, account, stage, outcome, amount, probability, expected close, owner. Optionally filter by stage, outcome, account_id or owner_id.

stage.description: Only deals in this stage (e.g. qualify, propose, negotiate, won, lost)

owner_id.description: Only deals owned by this user

tools.name: get_opportunity
tools.description: Fetch one deal by id, including its lines and the quotes created from it.

tools.name: list_rfqs
tools.description: List the tenant's RFQs (requests for quotation sent to suppliers when no cost or price was found): ref, title, status, what each was raised from, reply deadline. Needs an API key explicitly scoped to "rfqs".

status.description: draft, sent, partially_replied, replied, awarded, closed or cancelled

origin_type.description: What it was raised from: standard_quote, quote, opportunity, case, inspection_report, work_order, fence_project, pricing or manual

origin_id.description: Only RFQs raised from this record

tools.name: list_standard_quotes
tools.description: List the tenant's standard quotes (the Standard Quotes module, separate from Quotations): ref, status (draft, sent, accepted, rejected, expired), customer account, validity, header discount, tax and shipping, subtotal and total, and how many lines each has, and the ERP invoices rolled up (invoice_count, invoiced_total, paid_total). Contacts are returned as an id only. Needs an API key scoped to "standard_quotes" (or to all objects).

status.description: draft, sent, accepted, rejected or expired

opportunity_id.description: Only quotes linked to this deal

tools.name: list_sales_orders
tools.description: List the tenant's sales orders (the Sales Orders module): ref, order type, status (draft, confirmed, cancelled), customer account, customer PO, pricing mode, subtotal, discount, tax, shipping and total, requested and expected delivery dates, what it was made from, and how many lines each has. Contacts are returned as an id only and a bill-to / ship-to as name and address only. Needs an API key scoped to "sales_orders" (or to all objects).

source_id.description: Only orders made from this quote or deal

tools.name: list_abm_programs
tools.description: List the tenant's ABM (account-based marketing) programs: goal, time window, status and how many companies are targeted.

status.description: draft, active, paused, completed or archived

tools.name: get_abm_program
tools.description: Fetch one ABM program by id with its funnel counted by company: targets, reached, engaged, in talks, in a deal, won, and the money linked to its deals.

tools.name: list_abm_targets
tools.description: List ABM target accounts (a company inside a program): tier, progress, next step and linked deal. Buying-group people are not listed. Needs an API key explicitly scoped to "abm_targets".

progress.description: planned, reached, engaged, in_talks, deal_open, won, lost or dropped

program_id.description: Only the companies of this program

tools.name: get_abm_target
tools.description: Fetch one ABM target account by id with its buying group given as contact ids and roles only (no names, contact details or notes). Needs an API key explicitly scoped to "abm_targets".

tools.name: get_rfq
tools.description: Fetch one RFQ by id with its lines, the suppliers asked, each supplier's quoted prices and which line was awarded to whom. Needs an API key explicitly scoped to "rfqs".

tools.name: get_standard_quote
tools.description: Fetch one standard quote by id with its lines (description, quantity, rate, discount, amount, option group and whether it counts toward the total), introduction, notes and terms. Line margin checks, supplier-request links and contact details are never returned. Needs an API key scoped to "standard_quotes" (or to all objects).

tools.name: get_sales_order
tools.description: Fetch one sales order by id with its lines (description, printed text, quantity, unit price, discount, tax, line total, requested date, and the confirmed quantity and date with where that answer came from: the ERP or master data), notes and terms, and erp_documents: the invoices and deliveries the ERP reported for the order (number, date, due date, amount, currency, status). The creator, cancellation note, contact details and attachments are never returned. Needs an API key scoped to "sales_orders" (or to all objects).

tools.name: list_estimates
tools.description: List the tenant's project estimates: ref, name, status, customer, the template used and the price quoted to the customer before and after tax. Costs, margin and the bill of materials are internal and never returned. Needs an API key explicitly scoped to "estimates".

tools.name: get_estimate
tools.description: Fetch one project estimate by id: customer, template, status and quoted price (before and after tax). Never costs or margin. Needs an API key explicitly scoped to "estimates".

tools.name: list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders raised to suppliers, optionally filtered by status or supplier.

tools.name: get_purchase_order
tools.description: Get full purchase order detail including line items and receiving progress.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List customer invoices with totals, paid amount and status. Optionally filter by status or account.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Get full invoice detail including line items, balance due and payment history.

tools.name: list_employees
tools.description: List staff records for this tenant — employee code, name, work email/phone, department, designation, employment dates, status. Personal data: the API key must be scoped to "employees" explicitly (the all-objects wildcard does not cover it), and the tenant must have the employees module enabled.

status.description: Filter by status: active or inactive

tools.name: get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee record by id, including any tenant-defined custom fields.

id.description: Employee id (UUID) as returned by list_employees

coming_soon_tools: create_case — open a new service case
update_case_status — advance case through the workflow
create_quotation — create a new quotation with line items
send_email — send a quotation or report by email
send_whatsapp — send a message to a contact via WhatsApp Business API
